newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Mutual to form London-based reinsurer.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Mutual to form London-based reinsurer.

text.p: Liberty Mutual Group on Wednesday said it would form form Liberty Re, a London-based reinsurer with a diversified international portfolio, including property, casualty, life and health.
Liberty Mutual will commit $400 million to Liberty Re and has appointed John Engestrom, former chief executive of Mercantile and General Re, as chief executive.
The new company must be approved by the British Department of Trade and Industry.
"I am very excited about this unique opportunity to create a new reinsurer with such commitment from the parent," said Engestrom.
Gary Countryman, chief executive of Liberty Mutual said:

"We are confident that in the combination of Liberty Mutual's considerable experience in insurance and a proven management team under John Engestrom's leadership we have the foundation for success in this new venture." ((-- New York Newsrom 212 859 1610))
